''See also: [[Clockworker Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Clockworker, whose real name is [[Jyrid]], is an elderly human male and a long-standing member of [[the Advocates]]. He is a scholar or researcher by nature, characterized by his gray hair and intellectual appearance. As an [[Advocate]], he wears a bronze full-body suit marked with the organization's insignia and a specialized helmet featuring clockwork elements. He possesses versatile shimmering powers that allow him to immobilize physical objects regardless of their velocity or power. Despite being a highly trusted associate of [[Starhammer]] for many years, he was eventually accused of betrayal by the organization.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|[[Jyrid]] is an elderly human man with gray hair. He wears a bronze full-body suit featuring the [[Advocate]] 'A' on his chest and a matching bronze helmet that operates using the hands of an ancient clock.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|A prominent member of [[the Advocates]], [[Jyrid]] eventually betrayed his organization. His actions resulted in him letting [[Starhammer]] down.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|He possesses the power to lock physical objects in place.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Clockworker is the name used by [[Jyrid]], an elderly human man with gray hair and a prominent member of [[the Advocates]]. He wears a full-body suit of bronze featuring the [[Advocate]] 'A' on his chest and a helmet that operates using the hands of an ancient clock. Possessing the power to lock physical objects in place, he eventually betrayed his fellow [[Advocates]]. Through this betrayal, he let [[Starhammer]] down.}}
